caption: The drawing shows a tall, freestanding wooden object with a polished, dark brown finish. The object has a rectangular box-like section near the top, featuring a small round drawer pull at the front. Above this box are several vertical cylindrical pegs and a central turned spindle that ends with a round, flat platform and a knob on top. The box is supported by a single, slightly bulbous and tapering central column, which is ornately turned. This column is connected to a tripod base with three elegantly curved legs. The drawing also includes two additional elements: near the bottom left is a small-scale version of the main object, and in the bottom right corner there is a line drawing that provides a top-down, circular schematic view of the object's structure, showing concentric rings and several small circles which may indicate the placement of screws or pegs. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Sewing Stand
